title: 2021 Forest River Arctic Wolf **TURN KEY SERVICE**
description:
Hello and welcome to Big Dawg LUX. A "Turn Key" luxury RV rental service!

We include everything from your pillows and bedsheets to outdoor chairs and fire pit. Our goal is bringing the comfort of your own home to the outdoors. No more hauling tents & chairs.

Let us know where you want to go and we'll deliver everything for you anywhere in FL for $2.50 per mile starting from Tampa. All we have to do is change the location of the camper to whatever campsite and book it at that location.

The space
This RV is as spacious as it gets. 43ft long with 9 foot ceilings. You won't find the comfort or amenities in any other camper. There are also 3 flat screens with a mobile hot spot and Netflix. All included for free!!!!

Guest access
I will be present to hand you the keys and answer any questions you might have.

Other things to note
Shoot me a message and I can even help you book your campsite!
